title: Taiwan's President Reaffirms Resolve to Defend Freedom Amid Cross-Strait Tensions
detail: Taiwan's president reaffirmed that Taiwan will not surrender its freedom despite valuing peace, signaling continued resolve amid ongoing cross-strait tensions. The statement underscores Taiwan's position that any engagement with Beijing must not come at the cost of its democratic freedoms and way of life.

media.caption: Taiwan's president reaffirms the island will not give up its freedom
